oatcake_cook.text: Oatmeal, flour, yeast, water and milk. Leave it to bubble, pour it on the hot plate, flip it. That's it. That's the secret. Don't tell anyone.
What can I get you, duck?

else.text: You'll want the recipe first. Help out at the hatch and the lady might teach you.

oatcake_regular.text: Cheese, bacon and brown sauce, rolled. I've had the same order every Saturday for thirty years. My doctor knows. My doctor has the same.
